title: C++: Semver Parser
description: Parse semantic version strings and compare them.

steps.title: Parse and Compare
steps.description: Create a Semver struct with major, minor, patch. Write Semver parse(string s) and int compare(Semver a, Semver b). Test with '1.2.3' vs '1.10.0'.
hints: Compare major first, then minor, then patch.
